image_description: A group of people, including children and adults in colorful costumes (red skirts, black tops), are dancing around a tall wooden pole decorated with multi-colored ribbons (streamers) extending from the top. The setting is outdoors on a grassy area with bare trees in the background, suggesting a spring festival or May Day celebration.
